title: Looking for Beta Testers - Sept 14 to 21
author: macronancer
selftext:
Hey devs!

I am doing a hackathon on Devpost and publishing a mobile game, start to finish, in less than 30 days. I am using Astra for pretty much all of the development and image gen.

Presently, I am looking for beta testers to sign up for my closed beta test on Google Play. I need help testing out general game mechanics and to get some feedback on the actual playability and hook factors.

Please check out my game page and fill out the form if you are interested in participating in the closed beta test.

I need to find 12 people ASAP to do testing this week (sept 14 to 21)! 

Please help if you can =)

[https://games.creocortex.com/food-plus-food/early-access](https://games.creocortex.com/food-plus-food/early-access)
